flora: Birch-like leaf (small, triangular or ovate shape with finely serrated edges)
Catkins (slender, cylindrical flower clusters hanging from branches)
Birch-like sapling (very thin, whip-like white stem with sparse green leaves)
Bark detail (papery white or light cream texture with distinct horizontal dark lines/lenticels)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded toy-like proportions; emphasis on the 'papery' peeling quality of the bark; tactile contrast between the smooth white trunk and the dark horizontal markings.

visual_logic.composition: A quadrant tiled composition: Top-Left: A single serrated leaf; Top-Right: A cluster of hanging catkins; Bottom-Left: A thin, young sapling; Bottom-Right: A high-detail close-up of the papery white bark with horizontal lenticels.
visual_logic.ground: Fine grey volcanic ash mixed with small buff-colored pebbles.
visual_logic.lighting: Clear, even, bright diffused daylight to make the white bark pop against the neutral ground.
